title: Potatoverse Cast Ecology — Being × Identity × Role × State × Archetype
status: canonical project taxonomy / source-bounded role grammar
purpose: Unify Potatoes, Tomatoes, Dogs, Dwellers, Farmers, Cows, Footstools, Angels, Turbles and human character archetypes without turning scene-level labels into immutable human essences.
first_principles: A person is not a role.
A role is not automatically a species.
An archetype describes function in a scene; a symbolic ecology label describes relation, identity, state or project metaphor.
Literal biology, public identity, literary character and spiritual/project symbolism are separate evidence classes.
Named role assignment requires a dated/source-bounded scene unless the subject explicitly adopts the identity or the object is itself a created being.
Every shadow role must preserve an exit or counterform; the system should model transformation rather than permanent damnation.

entity_class.definition: What kind of thing is being represented?

archetype.definition: What function does the character perform in a bounded scene?

symbolic_role.definition: What project-specific relation or orientation is being enacted?

location_or_medium.definition: Where/through what medium is the role occurring?

role_families.label: Potato
role_families.kind: identity / growth-symbol / literal plant / community badge depending context
role_families.neutral_core: Buried storage, resilience, nourishment, eyes/sprouting, replication and growth from soil.
healthy_forms: Potato Angel where creative canon explicitly says so
transitions: Mud → Root → Potato → Sprout → Tree → Fruit
role_families.boundary: A real person called a Potato is not biologically a potato; community/spiritual identity and botany stay separate.

role_families.label: Tomato
role_families.neutral_core: A Solanaceae neighbor to potato; Great Book chapter 35 gives Tomato vitality, beauty and vulnerability rather than one fixed negative essence.
role_families.boundary: Do not treat Tomato as a permanent enemy species. Rahu's 15 Dec 2024 tomato-villain role is a scene performance; Brink's 'Tomato Apostle' is an old-source alias; neither proves a timeless moral identity.

role_families.label: Dweller
role_families.neutral_core: One who inhabits a plane, room, environment or relational field.
shadow_or_failure_forms: Mud Dweller when unresolved residue becomes home/identity
role_families.boundary: Dweller is morally neutral until the inhabited field and relation are specified.

role_families.label: Dog
role_families.neutral_core: Tracking, signaling, loyalty, warning, following cues, guarding boundaries.
transitions: Dog → Farm Dog through pack reward/pursuit
Dog → Farmer when chasing becomes infrastructure/classification
role_families.boundary: Dog is a role, not a species of moral person and not a permanent label for named individuals.

role_families.label: Farmer
role_families.neutral_core: Defines enclosure, manages cycles, classification, persistence, access and harvest.
transitions: Farmer → Mud Dweller when the system becomes identity/dependency
role_families.boundary: Farming tools and systemizing traits are not inherently sinister; outcome and relation determine valence.

role_families.label: Cow / calf
role_families.neutral_core: Subject around which Farm attention and extraction may organize; also nourishment/dependence imagery.
role_families.boundary: Cow is not a victim essence and must not erase a real person's agency.

role_families.label: Footstool
role_families.neutral_core: Lower/supporting relation beneath Seat/Throne; can also represent a small local state containing an unfound Door.
role_families.boundary: Never use Footstool as permission to degrade a real person's human worth.

role_families.label: Angels / Potato Angels / Turbles
role_families.neutral_core: Creative/canonical beings with explicitly authored traits rather than role-labels assigned to ordinary people.
role_families.boundary: Created-being traits remain creative canon unless a source explicitly states metaphorical comparison to a real person.

role_families.label: Sheep / swine / serpents / hyenas / goats
role_families.neutral_core: Contextual project metaphors inherited from religious, literary and internet-language layers.
role_families.boundary: Never treat animal-label metaphors as zoological, clinical or immutable classifications of people; always retain scene/source.

archetype_vs_role_examples.note: Cultivation function is more stable than any species-label.

transition_grammar: Mud can become Soil through Root/integration.
Dweller can become Mud Dweller when habitation hardens into identity.
Mud Dweller can move toward Root/Door through recognition and source-checking.
Dog can become Guardian Dog or Farm Dog depending evidence, stopping conditions and proxy incentives.
Farmer can become Gardener when extraction becomes regenerative stewardship.
Tomato can be healthy fruit, comic counter-symbol or rotten fruit; rot is a state, not the essence of Tomato.
Potato can remain buried, sprout, branch and fruit; Potato is developmental rather than automatically morally superior.
A person can change archetype between scenes without changing identity.
